verification.selector: GitHub App distribution, production-provider, webhook-route, replay, and secret-safety contract
GitHub App distribution plus adjacent GitHub automation governance integration slice
Changed-path lint, format, static typing, compilation, and diff integrity
verification.command: project-runtime-python -m ruff check; ruff format --check; mypy github_app_distribution.py; py_compile; git diff --check
verification.output: Ruff PASS; format PASS; mypy PASS; py_compile PASS; diff-check PASS

negative_cases: non-numeric production installation identity fails closed
provider status, permission, repository-selection, or selected-repository drift fails closed
app JWT and installation token values never enter receipts
wrong method, route, content type, missing authentication headers, or oversized body fails closed
webhook signature is validated in constant time before payload parsing
changed-byte delivery replay fails closed and exact replay never reinvokes the handler
secret-bearing or oversized handler results fail closed
limitations: No live GitHub App credential or repository installation was available or used; the production adapter is verified against the official endpoint contract through an injected HTTPS transport.
The route is an executable bounded dispatcher contract; host deployment and secret injection remain external configuration rather than source-embedded authority.
The installed plugin is unchanged; installation remains owned by a later governed release row.
